{{Quote|The main ingredients are cyanogen silicate, ardanium and accellerite, but don't worry&mdash;I'm already mixing the solution and we're all still alive.|Archiban Frodrick Kimble|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
'''Accellerite''' was a chemical used in the creation of explosives.<ref name="Auro" /> In the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] siphoned accellerite from one of the chemical plants in the [[Labor Valley]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for use in their [[chemical bomb]].<ref name="Death">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Death Cloud|Corellia}}</ref> [[Core bomb]]s were a type of explosive that used accellerite and [[magnopium ferrocongregate]] as its main components,<ref name="Core">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Core Bomb}}</ref> and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was able to locate a core bomb aboard the luxury cruiser ''[[Aurorient Express]]''<ref name="Auro" /> in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]]<ref name="Aurorient Express Date">The events of [[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express 2|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express'' 2]] take place six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] take place in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].</ref> by scanning for traces of the two chemicals.<ref name="Auro" /> Core bombs also saw use during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Core" /> However, accellerite also had medical applications,<ref name="Looking for a Cure" /> as the [[xenopathologist]]<ref name="Ency">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]] used a combination of accellerite, [[ardanium]], and [[cyanogen silicate]] as well as other compounds to cure a rare [[Suudaa Nem'ro's disease|flesh-eating disease]]<ref name="Looking for a Cure" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">[[Suudaa Nem'ro]] appears in the finale of the Imperial Agent storyline as a member of the [[Star Cabal]], and the events of the Act III class finales are set in [[3640 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. As "Looking For a Cure" is part of the original base game, which ends in 3640 BBY with the [[Battle of Ilum]], the mission must thus occur in 3640 BBY..</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Accellerite was first mentioned in the [[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express'']]. The issue was written by [[Mike Kennedy]], penciled by [[Lucas Marangon]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Auro" /> on [[June 12]], [[2002]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54473/star_wars_qui-gon_obi-wan_-_the_aurorient_express_2002_2|text=Star Wars: Qui-Gon & Obi-Wan - The Aurorient Express (2002) #2}}</ref>
